description.short: Soundbite™ for Microsoft Teams enables next-gen collaboration and communications
description.full:
Soundbite™ for Microsoft Teams & Viva is the short-form communications platform that transforms employee engagement, communications, and collaboration.

Employees need the convenience of Soundbite™ to feel deeply connected to their work and hear directly from their leaders. With employee engagement at an all-time low, meeting overload, long form content, and endless emails are no longer best practice.

More than legacy communications and collaboration, Soundbite™ lets you share short-form content that engages with people where they work.

Soundbite™ streamlines short-form content creation, distribution, and engagement for everyone with our beautiful design and unprecedented user experience. Soundbite™ brings a breath of fresh air to communicators and collaborators with a consumer app-like convenience directly from Microsoft Teams.

With a unified experience for Microsoft Teams and Viva, Soundbite™ enables internal and external communications and next-generation hybrid collaboration for every type of team. 

Built for companies of all sizes and industries, Soundbite™ is a must-have tool for communications, marketing, and collaborative teams that want to communicate better.

Give it a try today! [https://soundbite.ai/contact/](https://soundbite.ai/contact/)

Note; you need to have an active Soundbite™ account to use this app.
